title: Megafire cooling + reignition
asserts: a 180 MW fire cools for a day and a half under broken cloud: E reaches 3.5, past the ordinary closing bar but short of the large-event one, so the megafire weakens instead of going no_longer_detected; the detection that returns 60 h later is past T_LINK and therefore seeds a second event carrying a possible_reignition relation back to the first, on the same ground, inside the mixed-fuel window
